To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

“Patients who received an Artelon® Spacer implant for the treatment of stage I, II or III CMC joint arthritis had significant improvement in patient-oriented outcome scores and pinch and grip strength.

“Patients with Eaton stage 1, 2, or 3 arthritis of the carpometa carpal joint (CMJ) of the first ray who underwent surgery with the Artelon® spacer reported statistically significant improvement at a 48 months follow-up.”

“At a 48-month follow-up period, patients with arthritis of the thumb carpometacarpocarpal joint who received an Artelon Spacer implant showed statistically significant improvement on patient-reported functional outcomes and objective measures, with no evidence of implant failure or subsidence.”
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a new approach to the design and analysis of a multicenter clinical trial of a new implant for the thumb carpometacarpel (CMC) joints.
the study of the ArteloN® Spacer for treatment of thumb carpometacarpial (CMC) osteoarthritis.
the development of new and efficient methods for solving problems in the area of mathematical modeling and computer simulation.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
patients with CMC joint arthritis and disabling symptoms that have failed conservative management can be treated with the Artelon® spacer with good to excellent results.
the Artelon® implant is an effective treatment for thumb CMC arthritis.
this study demonstrated the safety and efficacy of the implant for the treatment of CMCJ osteoarthritis.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Artelon® spacer is a safe, effective treatment for CMCJ arthritis.
the Artelon® implant is a viable option for patients with thumb arthritis that is not responsive to conservative measures.
the implant is effective in the treatment of arthritis in the first CMC joint and that it is safe.

patients can expect to have improved function and pain relief after implant insertion.
the Artelon® spacer is a safe, effective, and durable implant for treatment of thumb carpometacarpals with osteoarthritis.
the Artelon Spacer is a safe, effective, and durable option for patients with CMCJ arthritis who have failed conservative treatment.
